description: This script handles the upgrade process for Netgear Orbi devices, including flashing kernel and root filesystem images, setting up loop devices, and performing necessary checks and reboots.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_netgear_orbi_upgrade
methods.description: Main function coordinating the upgrade process, verifying dependencies, locating partitions, and executing the flash process.

methods.name: netgear_orbi_do_flash
methods.description: Performs the actual flashing of kernel and root filesystem images, setting up loop devices, and handling backup restoration.
